items.title: AISI tests data filtering as a safeguard for open-weight biological models (pre-window)
items.summary_en: AISI reports on whether filtering pretraining data protects open-weight protein/biological models from misuse. According to the search snippet of the AISI blog index, filtering appears effective but may not hold up under later fine-tuning.
items.source_name: UK AI Security Institute Blog (index page, via search snippet)
items.notes: PRE-WINDOW (about 3.5 weeks before window start). Direct fetch of aisi.gov.uk failed (host not resolvable in this session), so this relies on a search-result snippet of the blog index; the individual post URL and the institute's own stated caveats were NOT verified. Date and wording should be checked against the original post before use.

items.title: AISI tests whether coding agents can re-create published biological AI tools (pre-window)
items.summary_en: AISI examined whether leading coding agents can rebuild published biological AI tools from limited information. Details of results were not available in the snippet.
items.source_name: UK AI Security Institute Blog (index page, via search snippet)
items.notes: PRE-WINDOW. Same access limitation as the other item: snippet only, no post-level URL, findings and methodology caveats not read. The search tool itself noted that dates on cached pages were mixed and approximate.

coverage_note: No AISI publication dated 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-21 was found. Direct access to www.aisi.gov.uk failed (hostname not resolvable; it needs to be added to the session's allowed network domains), so coverage relies on search snippets of the AISI blog and research index pages, which showed the newest posts as 2026-10-26 (and an Oct 23 research-page entry on Mythos 5 behaviour during a July 2026 incident, not itemised because its URL and details are unverified). An in-window post may exist that the cached snippets do not show; recommend a re-run with aisi.gov.uk allowed. Third-party coverage seen (MLex 2026-11-03 on frontier model access; Tech Policy Press 2026-11-17 on AISI model-access strain) was excluded under the primary-source-only rule. No contradictions with earlier weeks' AISI findings could be assessed.
